oak.description: Neutral pale oak veneer, fine longitudinal pores and sparse understated knots.

marble.description: Off-white ceramic marble print, sparse fine gray veins, no dark baked grout.

plaster.description: Neutral warm-white painted fine plaster; extremely subtle diffuse variation.

fabric.description: Neutral woven cotton twill tint base, with physically small warp and weft.

chair_mesh.description: Dark polyester chair mesh with actual alpha-cut holes; 5 mm woven grid.

granite.description: Dark polished granite with fine pale mineral flecks; not glossy black plastic.

brushed_metal.description: Neutral stainless steel, fine directional machining marks and restrained roughness.

bath_brown.description: Muted warm-brown bathroom porcelain, fine stone grain and matte floor finish; grout is geometry.

bath_ivory.description: Warm ivory glazed bathroom wall tile, restrained non-flat surface; grout is geometry.
